questions.q: Which instrument keeps the drone in Hindustani classical music?
questions.why: The tanpura plays the drone throughout; tabla keeps the tāla.

options: A clave rhythm with call and response
A build up and drop made with a synthesiser
A bandoneón solo with no percussion
questions.why: Clave plus coro answering the sonero is core salsa.

questions.q: A texture where each player plays their own decorated version of the same tune is...
questions.why: Heterophonic: typical of silk and bamboo and Arab takht music.

questions.q: Describe how a Hindustani rāga performance develops. [3]
questions.model: It begins with a slow, free ālāp with no tabla, then jōr with a steady pulse, then a very fast jhālā, and finally a gat with tabla playing a fixed composition.
